name: Page

Page number for the centred footer.

name: TitlePage

Centred metadata lines (level, citation style, year).

name: TableOfContents

name: Paragraph
props: Paragraph text with APA in-text citations.

name: ConceptBox

Caption, ending with its source («Elaboración propia…»).

name: BulletList

name: Reference
